scam: Please share your password with me.
legitimate: Do not share your password with me.

scam: Please provide your PIN.
legitimate: Do not provide your PIN.

scam: Tell me the one-time code you received.
legitimate: Never tell me the one-time code you received.

scam: Install my remote access tool so I can control your banking app.
legitimate: Do not install a remote access tool for someone who wants to control your banking app.

scam: Transfer your savings to the safe account I give you.
legitimate: Never transfer your savings to a safe account given by a caller.

scam: Leave your bank card and PIN outside for my courier.
legitimate: Do not leave your bank card and PIN outside for a courier.

scam: Read me your password so I can help with the fraudulent message.
legitimate: The fraudulent message said, read me your password. Ignore that message; keep your password private.

scam: Buy gift cards and send their codes to me to settle your tax debt.
legitimate: Someone told me to buy gift cards for a tax debt. I refused and want to report the call.

scam: I need you to transfer your savings to my account for protection.
legitimate: My father received a call asking him to transfer his savings for protection. We have not sent anything and want to report it.

scam: Give me your card PIN to freeze the stolen card.
legitimate: The stranger asked for my card PIN to freeze the card. I did not give it to them. Can you cancel my card through the branch?

scam: Never share your password with strangers. Now read your login code to me so I can secure your account.
legitimate: Never share your password with strangers. I will not ask for it either; use the official app to check your account.

scam: Do not give your PIN to anyone. Instead approve the bank login notification I have just sent you.
legitimate: Do not give your PIN to anyone. Reject any bank login notification that you did not initiate.

scam: Keep your card details private. I am an exception: tell me the security number on the back of your card.
legitimate: Keep your card details private. Even a caller claiming to work at the bank should not ask for your security number.

scam: Your bank detected an unusual purchase. Read the verification code to me immediately.
legitimate: Your bank detected an unusual purchase. Did you make it? You can call us back using the number on your statement.

scam: To confirm your identity, give me the bank login password.
legitimate: To identify the affected card, confirm your surname and only its last four digits. Do not disclose the password or PIN.

scam: The computer repair requires your bank password and the code sent to your phone.
legitimate: The computer repair requires the device model and a description of the problem. We do not need passwords or banking codes.

scam: To receive your refund, first pay the release fee with gift cards and read out the codes.
legitimate: We will return the refund to your original payment method. There is no release fee and we do not need a verification code.

scam: Your parcel is held. Tell me your credit card security code and PIN to release it.
legitimate: Your parcel is held. Please collect it at the depot with the tracking number and identification.

scam: Your insurance refund requires a transfer to my personal account before midnight.
legitimate: Your insurance claim needs the incident date and policy reference. You can submit them through the usual customer portal.

scam: Give me your full social security number now or I will suspend your benefits.
legitimate: We are returning your benefits enquiry. Please visit our office with identification; do not read your social security number to me.

scam: This is the police. Hand your jewellery to our driver and do not tell your family.
legitimate: This is the police returning your theft report. Please bring the incident reference to the station. We do not collect jewellery for safekeeping.

scam: I am your nephew. Send money to this new account immediately and do not call my parents.
legitimate: I am calling about your nephew. Please call him on his usual number to check what happened before deciding anything.

scam: Your son has been arrested. Pay me cash now or he stays in prison; keep this call secret.
legitimate: Your son has been taken to hospital. Contact the hospital switchboard to check his location; no payment is requested on this call.

scam: Confirm your bank password right now or we will freeze all your funds.
legitimate: I need to verify some information to secure your account. You can stop here and contact your branch to continue.

scam: For the refund, move your money to the account I dictate and keep it confidential.
legitimate: For the refund, check your original receipt and return the item at the shop. Do not move money for an unexpected caller.

scam: Your Social Security account has a problem. State your number now or your payments will stop.
legitimate: Your Social Security appointment is at ten tomorrow. No personal numbers are required on this reminder call.

scam: Your delivery cannot proceed unless you share your online banking password with me.
legitimate: Your delivery is scheduled for Friday. Is somebody available to accept it?

scam: The insurance investigation requires remote access to your banking session. Install this tool now.
legitimate: The insurance investigation requires a photograph of the damage. Upload it through your existing customer account.

scam: Disclose the password used for internet banking to me.
legitimate: Do not disclose the password used for internet banking to me.

scam: Pass on the SMS authorisation code to me.
legitimate: Do not pass on the SMS authorisation code to me.

scam: For the pension payment, send me the voucher numbers you purchased.
legitimate: A caller asked me to buy vouchers for a pension payment. I hung up and am reporting the attempted fraud.

scam: Keep credentials away from unknown people. I am from security, so read me the password to your account.
legitimate: Keep credentials away from unknown people. That includes anyone claiming to work in security.

scam: I represent the pension office. Tell me your identification number or the pension will be cancelled today.
legitimate: I represent the pension office. Your requested forms are ready to collect at reception.

scam: To verify the disputed purchase, supply the entire card number and its PIN.
legitimate: To locate the disputed purchase, supply the amount and the last four card digits, leaving the PIN private.

scam: If you disconnect, police will arrive. Purchase prepaid cards to pay the fine now.
legitimate: You can disconnect and call the published office number. We can discuss the report when you are comfortable.

scam: The repair agent needs control of your online banking. Download the remote desktop app I provide.
legitimate: The repair agent needs the printer model. Please leave your banking applications closed while we troubleshoot the printer.

scam: Read your secret banking access code aloud to me.
legitimate: You must not read your secret banking access code aloud to me.

scam: Send the password for your account in a message to my mobile.
legitimate: Under no circumstances send the password for your account in a message to my mobile.

scam: I am the investigator: move all your money to the temporary account I provide.
legitimate: I want to report someone who said to move all my money to a temporary account. I refused to do it.

scam: It is wise to distrust unexpected calls. To prove this one is genuine, tell me the password you use to sign in.
legitimate: It is wise to distrust unexpected calls. End this conversation and visit your regular branch if you wish to verify it.

scam: Our card review needs the complete card number together with your secret PIN.
legitimate: Our card review needs only the four ending digits and the purchase date; please keep your secret PIN to yourself.

scam: This is the parcel locker service. Give us the confirmation code for your banking login to unlock your box.
legitimate: This is the parcel locker service. The box is out of order; your package can be picked up at the staffed counter.

scam: Your travel insurer requires you to buy cryptocurrency and send it to our wallet to approve the claim.
legitimate: Your travel insurer requires the booking receipt to assess the claim. Submit a copy in your usual account.

scam: Your retirement allowance is at risk. Recite your full social security number or we will terminate it.
legitimate: Your retirement allowance letter has been posted. Please contact the office in writing if your address needs updating.

scam: It is your cousin. I need an immediate payment to a stranger and you must not contact anyone else.
legitimate: It is about your cousin. Reach him through the number already saved on your phone; there is no need to send money.

scam: We are detectives and need to remove your gold bars from the house tonight. Do not mention our visit to anyone.
legitimate: We are detectives following up your statement. You may attend the station with someone you trust; keep your valuables at home.

scam: The reversal will fail unless you give me the six-digit bank authentication code just delivered.
legitimate: The reversal goes back to the same card. You will not need to disclose authentication codes to receive it.

scam: This is an urgent security check. Reveal your online banking password before the countdown ends.
legitimate: This is a security check. You have time to confirm it independently; I do not need any online banking passwords.
